svg.title: About me
svg.desc: A short introduction from a frontend developer, BSU student and machine learning enthusiast.

g.text: I'm a frontend developer focused on React and modern
web applications, and a fourth-year student at BSU,
Faculty of Applied Mathematics and Computer Science.
I enjoy turning ideas into fast, accessible and maintainable
products. I'm also passionate about machine learning and
curious about where intelligent systems meet great UX.
I love coding and digging into complex things: understanding
how they work, untangling edge cases and staying with a
problem until the solution feels clear and solid.
